cases.name: Emily Teresa Finn
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Emily graduated from Sayville High School in June.  An avid dancer, Emily loved ballet from a very young age.  She was currently a Freshman at SUNY Oneonta where she was an Early Childhood/Elementary Education Major with a minor in Dance."
